blocks.label: state after 4 attempts (every durable row)
blocks.pre:
binding  state=RECOVERY_BLOCKED  lease=null  lossEvidence=null  stopEvidence=null   no new worker
record   state=RETIRED (or LAUNCHING pid=0)   .ready 0-277 B
why      observeDurable(): RETIRED/absent && lastLease == null  -> UNKNOWN  -> reconcileLoop retries to the deadline
         LAUNCHING/INTENT -> UNKNOWN; observation never spawns, so nothing ever advances these records
trigger  also a Broker crash between saving REGISTERED and writing the boot bytes: the worker reads EOF and
         exits 1 after 417 ms ('boot payload is invalid'), which leaves the same REGISTERED -> RETIRED record

blocks.note: Safety holds (no relaunch), but no terminal state is ever reached. Clients see a retryable 503 that costs the full operation deadline on each attempt. For LEGACY this turns a failure the default mode recovers from into a permanent wedge. With the 3-line candidate A, the same runs return 409 runtime_broker_resource_conflict (non-retryable) in about 100 ms.
